evals.prompt: 첨부한 case.pdf 논문을 바탕으로 시험 문항을 만들어 주세요.
evals.expected_output: Mode B: three Korean items on three different physician tasks, article notes, and one cropped figure in a stem.
expectations: Exactly three item files are saved in items/, each testing a different physician task
items/<topic>_article-notes.md is saved and groups findings by physician task
The response names the physician task that was left out and why
Each item has five options numbered 1-5 and no 'all/none of the above' option
Each evidence section quotes a passage that appears verbatim in case.pdf, with its location
At least one item embeds a PNG cropped from an article figure in its vignette, with no panel labels or asterisks
The neurocysticercosis route-of-infection item, if present, keys egg ingestion rather than undercooked pork
Vignettes are fictionalized: age, sex, and timeline differ from the 45-year-old man in the article
All item text is Korean, with English terms in parentheses at first mention
The response ends with a summary table by topic and physician task, plus answer-key and item-level distributions

evals.expected_output: Mode A: four Korean items covering all four physician tasks.
expectations: Exactly four item files are saved, one for each of the four physician tasks
No more than one item is at the 암기형 level
The diagnosis item does not name the parasite or disease in the stem
Correct-answer positions are not all the same
References are verifiable guidelines or textbooks, or are marked 출처 확인 필요(source verification required)
No quotation marks are used for remembered textbook wording
